rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.7% on 8.75x relative volume and has been trading in the lower quarter of today's range (24%), suggesting continued selling pressure, but the last few 1-minute candles show choppy, low-volume price action with no clear directional momentum or structure to anchor a reliable entry.
